description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

summary.one_liner: A pack of 25 Markdown workflow skills that teach AI coding agents to follow senior-engineer practices across the development lifecycle, from spec and planning through build, verification, review, and shipping.
keywords: share workflows with my ai agent
make my ai agent follow best practices
use_cases: Making an AI coding agent write a spec before code
Enforcing test-driven development in agent-written changes
Running structured code reviews before merging
Auditing web performance with Core Web Vitals checks
Setting up CI/CD and observability for a project
Planning staged rollouts and launch checklists
notable: Nine lifecycle slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship and others) that activate the matching skills
Each skill includes steps, verification gates, and anti-rationalization tables
/build auto generates a plan and implements tasks in one approved pass, still test-driven and committed per task
Portable core in a shared skills/ directory, with adapters for many agent hosts
Covers Google engineering concepts such as Hyrum's Law, the test pyramid, and Chesterton's Fence
caveats: Per-skill npx installs omit the shared references/ directory, so some supplementary checklist links break (tracked in issue #361)
Lifecycle slash commands are Claude Code commands and do not appear in GitHub Copilot; some Antigravity CLI releases do not expose the wrapper commands
Cursor has no checked-in .cursor/ folder; users must copy skills and write rules themselves
